responsibility: Appends one immutable, content-addressed binding of the exact candidate source, vector contract and worker identity a verify_authored_source task runs over, exactly once per frozen task contract.
execution_location: in-process, cis-clean application process; no filesystem, network or host-action access beyond the authority store
failure_boundary: fail_closed — an unknown or non-recomputing task contract, a task_contract_hash or authorization_binding_hash that does not match the referenced contract, a candidate or vector-contract digest that does not match the exact bytes beside it, a blank entrypoint, a worker image that is not an immutable sha256 digest identity (sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters, never a mutable tag), an expected trusted-runner or worker digest that is not exactly 64 lowercase hex characters, and a task contract that already carries a binding all refuse before a row is appended
recovery_behavior: One binding per task contract, ever — task_contract_id is UNIQUE in SQL and checked again in code, so a retry after a successful append finds the existing row and refuses rather than appending a second, and a refused append leaves no partial row because the single insert either fully succeeds or is rejected
replacement_contract: A replacement must remain the single owner of task_execution_inputs, store the exact candidate and vector-contract bytes beside their own independently recomputed digests, hash into a domain tag distinct from every other CIS hash scheme, bind forward to the frozen task contract without re-deriving its facts, refuse rather than overwrite a second binding for one task contract, and expose a row-level digest recomputation any independent reader can call without trusting the row on its own word
evidence_produced: one immutable task_execution_inputs row per frozen task contract, carrying its own independent hash domain
an ExecutionInputRefused naming the task contract and the mismatched fact that caused the refusal
an ExecutionInputTampered whenever a stored row's hash domain, stored-byte digests or binding hash do not recompute
a deterministic execution_input_id derived from the task_contract_id alone
